intro: "Jarvis" is a personal AI agent that works while you don't: it watches your inbox, does research, drafts the work and checks in with you. Here are the eight steps, in order, using tools you can set up yourself.

free.title: Steps 1-2: A home and a harness
free.body:
Home: an always-on computer (a spare laptop or a small desktop like a Mac mini) or a cloud machine, so it can run 24/7.

Harness: the program that lets a model use tools and work in steps. Claude Code is the easiest place to start; open-source agent harnesses work too.

free.title: Steps 3-4: The model and who you are
free.body:
Pick a strong model (Claude, or another top model). Then write a file it reads every time:

Copy this inWrite me an "about me" file for my AI assistant. Ask me questions one at a time about: my business, my customers, my goals this quarter, how I like to work, my writing voice, and what it must never do without asking me. Then write the file.

free.title: Steps 5-6: Memory and skills
free.body:
Give it a notes folder it updates after every task (what it learned, what you decided). Then add skills: saved instructions for jobs you repeat, like "write my weekly newsletter" or "research a new lead".

Copy this inTurn what we just did into a reusable skill: a short instruction file with the steps, the inputs you need from me, and what a great result looks like.

free.title: Steps 7-8: Tools and channels
free.body: Connect email, calendar, files and your business apps (connectors or MCP servers). Then add a way to reach it from your phone, such as a messaging integration, so you can ask for work and approve it on the go.

free.title: Step 9: The dashboard and the rules
free.body:
Build one page that shows what Jarvis did today, what's waiting on you and what it plans next. And set the rules:

Copy this inNever send, post, pay, delete or sign anything without my explicit OK. When you need a decision, ask me in one message with the options.

Keep secrets (passwords, card numbers) out of its notes, and review its access regularly.
